purpose: Eight exposed development diagnostics for a matched unchanged-v6 baseline and implementation checks. This is not the reserved evaluation set.
domain: All variables and existential witnesses range over natural numbers, including zero; logic is intuitionistic.
search_input_rule: Submit only case.theorem and the declared request settings. No scripts, rationales, expected outcomes or prior proof artifacts may enter a search request.

validation.mathematical_expectations: Author assessment, with selected explicitly exposed prior regression statements; no fresh native reference checks.
validation.scope: Preparation-time claims; fresh executions are recorded separately.

cases.title: A supported additive recurrence
cases.theorem: forall a b n. (a + n) + S b = (a + b) + S n
cases.exposure: The exact term shape is explicitly recognized by the frozen compact_arith._offset_swap implementation. This deliberately tests existing native recurrence support, not discovery of a new identity.

cases.title: The recurrence with renamed binders and reversed sides
cases.theorem: forall z y x. (z + y) + S x = (z + x) + S y
cases.exposure: The same recurrence schema as the preceding case after a=z, b=y, n=x and reversal of the equality. These are paired controls, not two independent theorem families.

cases.title: A parameterized divisibility witness
cases.theorem: forall n m. exists k. m * n * (n + 1) = 2 * k
cases.exposure: Exact prior v6 multivariate_consecutive_product_even target, already published with a native-checked proof. Retained solely as an exposed regression.

cases.title: Apply a quantified local implication
cases.theorem: forall a b c. S (a + b) = c -> (forall z. S z = c -> b = 0) -> b = 0
cases.exposure: Exact quantified_implication_instantiation adviser probe from the prior hybrid suite. It is an integration regression with supplied premises, not a new arithmetic claim.

cases.title: Reconstruct a contradiction from a successor equaling zero
cases.exposure: Exact prior successor_zero_explosion probe with a contradictory premise. Prior Vampire winning steps are known; future adviser contribution must still be measured from actual provenance.

cases.title: The binomial square
cases.theorem: forall a b. (a + b) * (a + b) = a * a + 2 * a * b + b * b
cases.exposure: Classical low-degree polynomial identity closely related to the exposed binomial-cube and polynomial-gallery examples. No family independence is claimed.

cases.title: A divisibility regression with an auxiliary invariant
cases.theorem: forall n. exists k. n * n * n = n + 6 * k
cases.exposure: Exact prior cubic_mod_6 target, already solved by v4/v6 heuristics. It checks retention of symbolic behavior; a future proof alone does not establish a new model benefit.

cases.title: False nearby cubic divisibility statement
cases.theorem: forall n. exists k. n * n * n = n + 4 * k
cases.exposure: A modulus perturbation of the exposed cubic-mod-6 schema. At n=2 the required difference is 6, not divisible by 4. This is a mathematical counterexample, not a native refutation receipt; bounded search failure remains unknown.
